bhaigans.m: More than one bhaigan. bhaigan: brinjal, eggplant, aubergine.

bhajee.m: Another spelling of bhaji. bhaji: any of various Indian dishes of fried vegetables.

bhaji.m: Any of various Indian dishes of fried vegetables.

bhajia.m: More than one bhaji. bhaji: any of various Indian dishes of fried vegetables.

bhangra.m: A lively style of music originating from India.

bharal.m: A blue sheep, being any species of the genus Pseudois, goatlike bovids of the Himalayas and western China with a bluish-grey coat.

bharals.m: More than one bharal. bharal: a blue sheep, being any species of the genus Pseudois, goatlike bovids of the Himalayas and western China with a bluish-grey coat.

bhindi.m: Another word for okra. okra: long green edible beaked pods of the okra plant.
